--check-only.help: check log files and only display output on error

--check-version-only.help: Only compare the current and latest available versions (requires network, non-root only)

--error-if-file-empty.help: error if any files are empty

--error-if-no-records.help: error if all logfiles are empty

--ignore-missing-fields.help: do not make an error for lines with no pid, source, name, or level

--include-all-releases.help: Don't filter out pre-release release versions

--listen-address.help: The address to listen on for HTTP requests.

--log.help: set the log file path where internal debug information is written

--log-format.help: set the format used by logs ('text' (default), or 'json')

--max-volume-size.help: maximum size of volumes in bytes (inclusive)

--mount-info.help: the mount info for the Kata Containers runtime to manage the volume

--no-agent-unpack.help: do not unpack agent log entries

--no-network-checks, n.help: Do not run any checks using the network

--only-list-releases.help: Only list newer available releases (non-root only)

--quiet.help: suppress warning messages (ignored in debug mode)

--root.help: root directory for storage of container state (this should be located in tmpfs)

--runtime-endpoint.help: Endpoint of CRI container runtime service.

--sandbox-id.help: the target sandbox for setting the iptables

--show-default-config-paths, kata-show-d.help: show config file paths that will be checked for (in order)

--size.help: the new size of the volume

--spdk-rawpath.help: path for spdk rawdisk backing files

--spdk-vhostpath.help: path for spdk vhost controller sockets

--statedir.help: directory for storing state information across driver restarts, volumes

--storagepath.help: storage path for storing the backend files on host

--strict.help: do not tolerate misformed agent messages (generally caused by kernel writes to the console)

--systemd-cgroup.help: enable systemd cgroup support, expects cgroupsPath to be of form "slice:prefix:name" for e.g. "system.slice:runc:434234"

--verbose, v.help: display the list of checks performed

--volume-path.help: the target volume path the volume is published to
